(Currently Amended) Claim 281: A tool comprising: a lamination of at least two layers; a first adhesive layer and a second adhesive layer located on opposite sides of a medial section, wherein the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer are configured to be cured to each other, and wherein the first layer and the second layer are __aligned with__ the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer; and an additional adhesive layer configured to bond the medial section to the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer.  

(Currently Amended) Claim 282: The tool of claim 281, wherein the medial section comprises a metal.

(Currently Amended) Claim 283: The tool of claim 282, wherein the metal is a honeycomb structure.

(Currently Amended) Claim 284: The tool of claim 281, wherein the medial section is a composite material.

(Currently Amended) Claim 285: The tool of claim 281, further including a weld ring at least partially interposed between the perimeter of the first and second layers.

(Currently Amended) Claim 286: The tool of claim 285, wherein the weld ring is bonded to the medial section.

(Currently Amended) Claim 287: The tool of claim 285, wherein a plurality of cutting segments are welded to an outer perimeter of the weld ring.

(Currently Amended) Claim 288: The tool of claim 285, wherein the weld ring is continuous.

(Currently Amended) Claim 290: The tool of claim 285, further including an inner ring coupled on an inner perimeter to the medial section.

(Currently Amended) Claim 291: The tool of claim 290, wherein the inner ring includes a __central opening__ for accommodating a drive shaft.

(Currently Amended) Claim 293: The tool of claim 285, wherein a plurality of cutting segments are located on an outer periphery of the weld ring.

(Currently Amended) Claim 294: The tool of claim 285, wherein the weld ring is continuous.
